remarks: Welcome to this truly unique opportunity conveniently located in the heart of Stamford. Enjoy charming house-sized living with condo low-maintenance amenities that include pool, landscaping, and snow removal. This home offers a comfortable open layout with a generous living and dining area, perfect for both everyday living and entertaining. The kitchen features ample cabinetry, modern appliances, and great workspace for cooking. This unit has three bedrooms with a master suite, a roomy loft - perfect for office space, exercise room, plus two full bathrooms and one half bath. Enjoy the convenience of copious storage with a full basement and attic and assigned parking. Located walking distance from Metro North, downtown Stamford dining, theaters, shopping, library, schools, and parks. Also close to beaches and major highways, so whether commuting or staying local, this location can't be beat.
